name: Graveyard Corpse Auto-Resurrector
description: Automatically extracts AST, updates EARS specs, and synthesizes MCP tools whenever a legacy file is added or modified in /graveyard

actions.prompt: A legacy artifact in /graveyard was updated. Re-parse the schema, update .kiro/specs/necro-engine/requirements.md using EARS syntax, and regenerate the MCP tool bindings.
